title: Simple Epidemic Spread Simulation
description: Simulates the spread of a virus within a population of 1000 people using a simple model.

interactions.name: Transmission
interactions.description: An interaction between an Infected person and a Susceptible person, potentially resulting in the Susceptible person becoming Infected based on transmission probability.

metrics.name: susceptible_count
metrics.description: The number of individuals currently Susceptible to infection.

metrics.name: infected_count
metrics.description: The number of individuals currently Infected.

metrics.name: recovered_count
metrics.description: The number of individuals who have recovered from infection and are immune.

metrics.name: total_cases
metrics.description: The cumulative number of individuals who have been infected.

validation_criteria.name: population_stability
validation_criteria.description: The total number of individuals in the simulation remains constant (equal to population_size).

validation_criteria.name: status_transitions
validation_criteria.description: Individuals only transition between valid states (e.g., Susceptible -> Infected, Infected -> Recovered). No reverse transitions or skips.

validation_criteria.name: typical_curve_shape
validation_criteria.description: The 'Infected' count over time follows a typical epidemic curve shape (initial growth, peak, decline).
